text:
The plate looks like a square side plate of about 22 cm. It holds scrambled egg whites, or possibly an egg-white patty, with a yellowish sauce on top, plus one strip of what is probably turkey bacon or tempeh bacon.

The egg portion covers roughly 11 x 14 cm and is fairly fluffy, so I estimate about 150 g. Egg whites run about 52 kcal per 100 g, which gives roughly 80 kcal. If it is whole scrambled egg, it would be closer to 200 kcal, but the pale color points to whites.

The sauce looks like a curry or mustard-type sauce, around 15 g and 20 kcal. The bacon strip is about 15 g and 60 kcal.

That adds up to about 160 kcal over about 180 g. I'll round up slightly in case there is some oil in the egg.
